Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of HD.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.64 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
Our gross margin expanded by 40 basis points to 70.7%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $3.6 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $3.6 billion this quarter, representing 13% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
